steps.content: An enormous hand captures you suddenly. The scorch marks burn, spreading through the entire space.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Mmph... What... is this... The shackles... don't feel right?

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Shackles... It's the shackles... but... not her...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Just like her... Are you here to devour me too...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: No... No way... You... don't deserve it...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: You should die instead!!
The shackles are entangled with it, fighting it. A certain stronger emotion scorches your body and mind.

Is it the pain of losing a friend? Or the rage toward the layers of plot? Your true obsessive nature from your missing memories? An uncontrollable madness and agitation in the depths of your instinct?
You've lost too much of your sanity to recognize this emotion. Julien's figure is blurred now. He seems to be shouting something. You can't tell.
Slowly, a bizarre shape emerges in your vision. Like a red moon, an eye, or a throbbing fetus. It's calling to you, sucking you in...
Chief?!

steps.speaker: (Scene change)
steps.content: (Scene change)
A sharp cry breaks the illusion in your sight. Your mind clears up, though your vision is still blurry and crimson. A familiar figure barges into the office.

You can't speak. Viscous liquid clogs your throat, then leaks out from your nose and eyes, giving off a rusty smell. You can't tell what it is, but Hecate looks like she's witnessing the doom of the world.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare!

Nightmare lunges over, ripping up the Corpseborne instantly. The Sinner almost keels over as if she's been hit hard, but she immediately pushes herself up and runs to you. Your mind becomes clear at once.
The Forbidden Force works and the shackles lash out to pin her on the spot. But it's too late. Discovering the new prey, the Corpseborne roars ecstatically and charges at Hecate.
At that moment, rage and fear incinerate your remaining sanity. Howling, the red shackles shoot forward, piercing its body.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Ahhh! How dare you, even you...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Even you're trying to... You... How dare you?!
A massive surge of energy explodes within you, but it's not the shackles you know.

The blue light impales your consciousness. You feel pierced by a thousand icicles, the chill penetrating your bones. The red light binding the enemy disintegrates gradually, and the monster it restrains begins struggling.
What an... unexpected accident.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: I don't exist to help you succeed, not you... not her either!!

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: I won't die here!!

Numerous tentacles claw at you, roaring. Before they reach you and tear you up, a huge metallic structure knocks the creature several steps away. Julien clings to the console with all his strength. He's reached his limit. He only cries out to you.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Come over. The ground is collapsing!

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Sinners, go and save him! Quick...
steps.female_content: Sinners, go and save her! Quick...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Ahhh!
It growls, and a massive flow of energy hits you immediately. You're thrown off the ground, tossed out of the broken window, falling down rapidly.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No!! Nightmare, Nightmare?!
The girl's familiar has long been torn apart. Having lost the power she takes for granted, she freezes and just watches you tumble.

<size=32>The Drifter Camp's complex mechanical fortress rises up rapidly. Having lost control of your body, you keep getting hit. Something tries to catch you and protect you. Something soft. Something hard. But then it's all crushed and ripped apart. You continue falling.</size>

You hear the crowd's screams. Your mouth is filled with the taste of blood, cold air and scorching pain clashing in your senses. Time seems to have stilled. Pain puts you to sleep and wakes you up again. Until...
Bang!
[Scene Change]
You fall into complete darkness.
